_source: SIA 265:2021, clause 4.2.8, equations (29) to (37) -- transcribed by hand from the German edition, SIA265-2021-DE.pdf pp. 34-35, read off a render of the pages (the radicals of (30), (32) and (34) do not extract as text).
_note: k_c = 1 / (k + sqrt(k^2 - lambda_rel^2)) (30); k = k_factor · [1 + beta_c · (lambda_rel - lambda_rel_offset) + lambda_rel^2] (31); lambda_rel = sqrt(f_c,0,k / sigma_c,crit) (32), sigma_c,crit = pi^2 · E_0,05 / lambda^2 (33), so lambda_rel = lambda/pi · sqrt(f_c,0,k / E_0,05) (34), with f_c,0,k and E_0,05 from Anhang B (Tabellen 47 and 48) and lambda = l_k / i. The norm states lambda_rel > lambda_rel_limit beside (31) and Figur 10 draws k_c = 1 below it. beta_c by family: Vollholz stands for Vollholz, keilgezinktes Vollholz and Balkenschichtholz. slenderness_limits are guidance ("sollte in der Regel"). simplified_divisors are the Nadelholz shortcut of (35)/(36), lambda_rel = lambda / divisor, kept for the record: the calculation uses (34). Combined with bending: sigma_c,0,d/(k_c · f_c,0,d) + sigma_m,d/(k_m · f_m,d) <= 1 (37), per principal axis.
